title: Supplier Management — Create a Supplier
purpose: Add a supplier profile so you can link it to products, factories, documents and service jobs.
overview: Open **Supplier / Factory Management**, stay on the **Supplier** tab and click **Create Supplier**.

body: In the left menu, open **Supplier / Factory Management**. The **Supplier** tab lists your suppliers with their location, category, status, connect status and rating.
Click **Create Supplier**. You can also use **Import Supplier** to add many suppliers from a file, or **Invite Supplier** to invite a supplier to connect with you on QMAS.

body.caption: Supplier tab with Import Supplier, Create Supplier and Invite Supplier.

list: **Supplier Name**: English name (required) and local-language name (optional).
**Location**: country or region, then province and city.

body.caption: Create supplier profile — step 1, Company overview.

body: Under **2. Contact**, fill in the **Contact person**, **Contact Email** and at least one **Email address**. For each email address, choose a type: Company, QA, Sales or Other. Click **Add email** for more. **Contact no.** is optional.
If a required field is empty when you click **Next**, it turns red, for example “Type is required” or “Email is required”.

body.caption: The email type and email address are required.

body: Click **Select category** to choose the product categories this supplier offers. Click **Select tag** to add your own tags. Click **Next**.
Click **Add** to upload a certificate. Choose the certification type, upload the file, and fill in the rating, issue party and dates. Click **Done** to create the supplier.

The supplier profile opens. Use the tabs **Overview**, **Product**, **Factory**, **Certificate**, **Document** and **Compliance Data** to manage everything linked to this supplier. Click the pencil icon next to the name, or next to **Contact**, to edit.

tips: Search the Supplier list before you create a supplier so you don’t add a duplicate.
Consistent tags make filtering the list easier later.
faq: How do I create a new supplier?

Go to Supplier / Factory Management (https://qmas.icw.io/supplier-manager/suppliers), click Create Supplier, fill in Supplier Profile, then Next, Next and Done. Direct link: https://qmas.icw.io/supplier-manager/create
Can I add many suppliers at once?
Yes. Click Import Supplier on the Supplier tab.
How do I invite a supplier to QMAS?
Click Invite Supplier on the Supplier tab.
How do I edit a supplier?
Open the supplier from the list and click the pencil icon next to its name or next to Contact.
